footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to IDT: after $8.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Jul 31, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 5.4% to $1.3B in fiscal 2026 (ended Jul 31, 2026). Gross margin was 38.3%, versus 36.2% a year earlier, and operating income rose 20.7% to $121M, a 9.3% margin.
Net income rose 13.8% to $86.6M, or $3.46 per share. Operating cash flow was $91.1M and free cash flow $68.0M, versus $106M; IDT returned $6.5M through dividends.
sources: IDT Corporation Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
